title: neltuma peruviana
intro: Neltuma peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian maca, is a plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family and is native to the highlands of Peru. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its health benefits include enhancing fertility, improving hormonal balance, and supporting bone health, as well as providing antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Peruvian maca are attributed to its ability to stimulate hormone production, promote energy and vitality, and support mental clarity and focus. The bioactive constituents of Peruvian maca include macamides, macaridin, and isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have anti-cancer and anti-aging effects.
